explanation.headline: Nitrofurantoin is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale sites hold about 25.7 days of 50 mg capsules and the top alternate manufacturer is Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include nitrofurantoin as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 353 capsules of nitrofurantoin 50 mg at 13.7 per day, providing 25.7 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 409 capsules of nitrofurantoin 50 mg at 15.9 per day, also providing 25.7 days on hand.
The rule-based alternate manufacturer ranked first is Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited is named on label a8a0d7d7 as the plant for NDC 62332039031 with FEI 3004956904 in India and its last inspection was classified NAI on 2024-07-26.
FDA inspection records for that FEI show multiple VAI classifications from 2010 through 2020, with the most recent VAI inspection ending 2020-03-13 and known on 2020-06-11.
Buyer should verify current supply availability from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited and monitor FDA inspection updates for the registered plant.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Decision on acetaminophen, in the approver's words: "Transfer 22 bags of 10 mg/mL, 100 mL from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside". Rationale: Acetaminophen is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; internal inventory shows Corvale Lakeside at 8.8 days on hand.. Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.
